items.title: Medetomidine found in green ‘S 90 3’ pill
items.summary: [issued 30 October, published 1 Novemeber 2026] A green rectangular pill marked ‘S 90 3’ and two break lines splitting the pill into thirds, resembling an amprazolam (‘Xanax’) tablet, was submitted to CanTEST with uncertain expectations about its contents as either ‘alprazolam’ or ‘MDMA’. It has been identified as medetomidine, a potent non-opioid, non-benzodiazepine sedative. items.title: Nitazene found in a pale purple liquid sold as oxycodone
items.summary: Nitazenes are potent synthetic opioids that can produce life-threatening toxic effects in very small amounts The Victorian Pill Testing Service recently detected a nitazene in a pale purple liquid expected to contain oxycodone. No oxycodone was detected. Previously, one person has died after using a similar product sold as a drinkable mixture called ‘lean’. items.title: Protonitazene (or a closely related nitazene) detected in pale purple liquid expected to contain oxycodone
items.summary: No oxycodone was detected. The sample was in propylene glycol. This is similar to liquids that may be used to make opioid vapes or mixtures like “lean”. Nitazenes are highly potent synthetic opioids. Some nitazenes can be hundreds of times more potent than morphine. items.title: Nitazene found in a yellow tinted powder in Melbourne
items.summary: N-Desethyl Etonitazene is a potent synthetic opioid that can produce life-threatening toxic effects in very small amounts. One person has required emergency care after they experienced an opioid overdose after using an unknown yellow tinted powder. Specialised blood tests showed evidence of N-Desethyl Etonitazene, a novel synthetic opioid. Opioids are central nervous system depressants, typically producing a range of effects Read More The post Nitazene found in a yellow tinted powder in Melbourne first appeared on The Know .

items.title: Methamphetamine detected in samples expected to be ketamine
items.summary: The samples were found to contain ketamine and methamphetamine. What has been detected? Three separate samples of white crystals were tested at the Victorian Pill Testing Service. Methamphetamine was detected alongside ketamine in all samples. One of the samples also contained some fillers. Ketamine is a dissociative anaesthetic. Methamphetamine is a stimulant. items.title: Heroin found in expected ‘cocaine’ sample
items.summary: A white powder sample expected to contain cocaine was found to contain heroin and no cocaine. What does this mean? items.title: Meth found in expected ketamine sample
items.summary: A white powder sample was brought to CanTEST for testing, expected to contain ketamine. The sample was found to contain both methamphetamine (40% free base purity) and ketamine (34% free base purity). What does this mean? Ketamine is a dissociative anaesthetic, while methamphetamine is a stimulant.
